questions.question: In which year was Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj born at Shivneri Fort?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Shivaji Maharaj was born in 1630 at Shivneri Fort to Shahji Bhonsle and Jija Bai. He laid the foundation of the Maratha Empire.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शिवाजी महाराज का जन्म 1630 में शिवनेरी किले में शाहजी भोंसले और जीजा बाई के घर हुआ था। उन्होंने मराठा साम्राज्य की नींव रखी थी।

questions.question: Who was the religious teacher (Guru) of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Samarth Ramdas was the spiritual and religious teacher of Shivaji Maharaj who influenced his thoughts on Dharma.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
समर्थ रामदास शिवाजी महाराज के आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक गुरु थे जिन्होंने धर्म पर उनके विचारों को प्रभावित किया।

questions.question: The Battle of Pratapgarh (1659) was fought between Shivaji Maharaj and whom?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Shivaji Maharaj killed the Bijapur General Afzal Khan using 'Wagh Nakh' (tiger claws) during this battle.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शिवाजी महाराज ने इस युद्ध के दौरान 'वाघ नख' (बाघ के पंजे) का उपयोग करके बीजापुर के सेनापति अफजल खान को मार डाला था।

questions.question: The Treaty of Purandar (1665) was signed between Shivaji Maharaj and ________.
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Following the siege of Purandar, Shivaji had to surrender 23 of his forts to the Mughals under this treaty.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पुरंदर की घेराबंदी के बाद, शिवाजी को इस संधि के तहत अपने 23 किले मुगलों को सौंपने पड़े थे।

questions.question: In which year was Shivaji Maharaj coronated at Raigarh and took the title of 'Chhatrapati'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
He was coronated at Raigarh in 1674 and assumed the title of Chhatrapati and Haindava Dharmodharak.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
1674 में रायगढ़ में उनका राज्याभिषेक हुआ और उन्होंने छत्रपति और हैंदव धर्मोद्धारक की उपाधि धारण की।

questions.question: What was the council of eight ministers that helped Shivaji Maharaj in administration called?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Ashtapradhan was a council of eight ministers where each minister was directly responsible to the King.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अष्टप्रधान आठ मंत्रियों की एक परिषद थी जहाँ प्रत्येक मंत्री सीधे राजा के प्रति उत्तरदायी होता था।

questions.question: Which tax was collected by the Marathas as 1/4th of the land revenue?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Chauth was 25% of land revenue paid to Marathas to avoid raids and ensure protection.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चौथ मराठों को दिए जाने वाले भू-राजस्व का 25% हिस्सा था ताकि हमलों से बचा जा सके और सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित हो सके।

questions.question: Who was the first Peshwa of the Maratha Empire?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Balaji Vishwanath became the first powerful Peshwa in 1713 and made the post hereditary.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बालाजी विश्वनाथ 1713 में पहले शक्तिशाली पेशवा बने और उन्होंने इस पद को वंशानुगत बना दिया।

questions.question: The Third Battle of Panipat (1761) was fought during the tenure of which Peshwa?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Third Battle of Panipat was fought between Ahmad Shah Abdali and the Marathas in 1761. Balaji Bajirao (Nana Saheb) was the Peshwa of the Maratha Empire at the time. This battle proved decisive and devastating for the Marathas.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पानीपत की तीसरी लड़ाई 1761 ई. में अहमद शाह अब्दाली और मराठों के बीच लड़ी गई थी। उस समय मराठा साम्राज्य के पेशवा बालाजी बाजीराव (नाना साहेब) थे। यह युद्ध मराठों के लिए अत्यंत निर्णायक और विनाशकारी सिद्ध हुआ।

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Scindia dynasty of Gwalior?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ranoji Scindia established the Scindia house as part of the Maratha Confederacy.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
रणोजी सिंधिया ने मराठा परिसंघ के हिस्से के रूप में सिंधिया घराने की स्थापना की थी।

questions.question: Which Maratha ruler provided protection to Mirza Akbar, the rebellious son of Aurangzeb?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sambhaji, the elder son of Shivaji, protected Mirza Akbar, which led to Aurangzeb's invasion and Sambhaji's execution.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शिवाजी के बड़े पुत्र संभाजी ने मिर्जा अकबर को संरक्षण दिया, जिसके कारण औरंगजेब ने आक्रमण किया और संभाजी को मृत्युदंड दिया।

questions.question: The Battle of Khed (1707) was fought between whom?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Shahu defeated Tarabai in this battle after being released from Mughal captivity, securing his right to the throne.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मुगल कैद से छूटने के बाद शाहू ने इस युद्ध में ताराबाई को हराया और सिंहासन पर अपना अधिकार सुरक्षित किया।

questions.question: The Treaty of Bassein (1802) was signed by which Maratha Peshwa with the British?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Baji Rao II signed the Subsidiary Alliance under the Treaty of Bassein, which led to the 2nd Anglo-Maratha War.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बाजीराव द्वितीय ने बसीन की संधि के तहत सहायक संधि पर हस्ताक्षर किए, जिससे द्वितीय आंग्ल-मराठा युद्ध हुआ।

questions.question: Who was known as the 'Machiavelli of Marathas'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Nana Fadnavis was a brilliant administrator and diplomat who managed Maratha affairs during the First Anglo-Maratha War.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
नाना फड़नवीस एक कुशल प्रशासक और राजनयिक थे जिन्होंने प्रथम आंग्ल-मराठा युद्ध के दौरान मराठा मामलों का प्रबंधन किया था।

questions.question: The 'Pindari War' is another name for which conflict?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Third Anglo-Maratha War (1817-1818) is often called the Pindari War as it began with British actions against the Pindaris.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
तृतीय आंग्ल-मराठा युद्ध (1817-1818) को अक्सर पिंडारी युद्ध कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह पिंडारियों के खिलाफ ब्रिटिश कार्रवाई के साथ शुरू हुआ था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Sardeshmukhi' tax:
2. It was claimed on lands where Marathas asserted hereditary rights.
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sardeshmukhi was a 10% additional tax claimed by Shivaji as the hereditary head (Sardeshmukh) of the region.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सरदेशमुखी एक 10% अतिरिक्त कर था जिसे शिवाजी ने इलाके के खानदानी मुखिया (सरदेशमुख) के तौर पर मांगा था।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): The Third Battle of Panipat was a decisive blow to Maratha expansion.
Reason (R): The Marathas lost their most able leaders and thousands of soldiers in this battle.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is correct explanation of A
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.c: A is true but R is false
options.d: A is false but R is true

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The heavy loss of manpower and leadership in 1761 halted the Maratha dream of ruling the entire Indian subcontinent.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
1761 में जनशक्ति और नेतृत्व की भारी हानि ने पूरे भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप पर शासन करने के मराठा सपने को रोक दिया।

questions.question:
Match the Maratha families with their seats of power:
1. Gaikwad - A. Indore
2. Holkar - B. Baroda
3. Scindia - C. Nagpur
4. Bhonsle - D. Gwalior
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Gaikwads ruled Baroda, Holkars in Indore, Scindias in Gwalior, and Bhonsles in Nagpur as part of the Confederacy.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गायकवाड़ ने बड़ौदा, होल्कर ने इंदौर, सिंधिया ने ग्वालियर और भोंसले ने नागपुर में परिसंघ के हिस्से के रूप में शासन किया।

questions.question:
Statement I: Shivaji Maharaj is considered a pioneer of Guerilla warfare in India.
Statement II: He developed a strong navy to protect the Konkan coast.
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Shivaji used the terrain of Sahyadri for Guerilla tactics and is also called the 'Father of Indian Navy'.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शिवाजी ने गुरिल्ला रणनीति के लिए सह्याद्रि के इलाके का इस्तेमाल किया और उन्हें 'भारतीय नौसेना का जनक' भी कहा जाता है।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): The post of Peshwa became hereditary after Balaji Vishwanath.
Reason (R): Shahu was a weak ruler and surrendered all powers to the Peshwa.

options.a: A is true, R is false
options.b: A is false, R is true
options.c: Both A and R are true but R is not the explanation
options.d: Both A and R are true and R is the explanation

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
While the post became hereditary, Shahu was not "weak" but relied on the Peshwa's administrative brilliance to expand the empire.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हालाँकि पद वंशानुगत हो गया था, शाहू "कमजोर" नहीं थे, बल्कि साम्राज्य के विस्तार के लिए पेशवा की प्रशासनिक कुशलता पर निर्भर थे।

questions.question: Which treaty ended the First Anglo-Maratha War in 1782?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Treaty of Salbai ensured peace between the British and Marathas for the next 20 years.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सालबाई की संधि ने अगले 20 वर्षों के लिए अंग्रेजों और मराठों के बीच शांति सुनिश्चित की थी।

questions.question:
Statement I: Rajaram succeeded the throne after the death of Sambhaji.
Statement II: He created a new post called 'Pratinidhi' in the council.
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Rajaram took over during a crisis and added 'Pratinidhi' to the Ashtapradhan, making it a council of nine.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राजाराम ने संकट के दौरान कमान संभाली और अष्टप्रधान में 'प्रतिनिधि' को जोड़ा, जिससे यह नौ सदस्यों की परिषद बन गई।

questions.question: The Treaty of Mandsaur (1818) was signed between British and which Maratha chief?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Following the Third Anglo-Maratha War, the Holkars signed the Treaty of Mandsaur in 1818.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
तृतीय आंग्ल-मराठा युद्ध के बाद, होल्करों ने 1818 में मंदसौर की संधि पर हस्ताक्षर किए थे।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): Baji Rao I is remembered as one of the greatest Maratha generals.
Reason (R): He never lost a battle in his career and captured Bassein from the Portuguese.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R explains A
options.b: Both A and R are true but R doesn't explain A
options.c: A is true, R is false
options.d: A is false, R is true

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Baji Rao I was a brilliant military strategist known for his rapid cavalry movements and undefeated record.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बाजीराव प्रथम एक शानदार सैन्य रणनीतिकार थे जो अपनी तीव्र घुड़सवार सेना और अजेय रिकॉर्ड के लिए जाने जाते थे।

questions.question: In 1818, the office of Peshwa was abolished and Baji Rao II was sent to which place?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
After the 3rd Anglo-Maratha War, the British abolished the Peshwaship and pensioned off Baji Rao II to Bithoor near Kanpur.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
तीसरे आंग्ल-मराठा युद्ध के बाद, अंग्रेजों ने पेशवा पद को समाप्त कर दिया और बाजीराव द्वितीय को कानपुर के पास बिठूर में पेंशन पर भेज दिया।
